Fees $20/$38 confirmed. Manual season 05-15/09-14 matches the 2026 page; 2027 opening is May 21 per RA (flag). AWH lakefront kept (T10, T14, T16 photos show lake views at the bank; T54/T55 through trees). Phone absent -> 802-584-3822. Pin at the entrance lot ~150 m from the loops: no move.
flags: SEASON (manual, not overwritten): stored 05-15/09-14 = the page's 'Third weekend in May to Monday, September 14.' for 2026. For 2027 the booking site says 'Closed through Thu May 20 2027', i.e. it opens Fri May 21 2027; the 2027 closing date is not posted. Reviewer may want the season note to say the dates move year to year.

WATERFRONT (--AWH lakefront, unchanged; no disagreement): the booking site tags T08 (20 ft), T10 (28), T14 (30), T16 (28), T54 (30) and T55 (20) 'Proximity to Water: Waterfront', all sold by the night. Their photos show T10, T14 and T16 at the top of the bank with open lake views between shoreline trees; T08, T54 and T55 see the lake through trees. Esri imagery shows the Loop A sites on the east-shore bank of Lake Groton (~44.2805,-72.2712).
PIN: stored 44.2799,-72.2740 is the entrance/contact-station parking lot; the two loops lie ~100-250 m east and south-east between it and the lake (centre ~44.2798,-72.2722, ~150 m). No move.
